constraints.description: System must provide detailed context-sensitive help material
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: System must provide interface for logging defects
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: System must send alerts when actions are taken
constraints.source_text: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

constraints.description: System must maintain unalterable audit trail
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word "unalterable" is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: System must allow limiting case access
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Only admins can set up user profiles
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.
The system should support multilingual interface.
The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL).

missingConstraintCandidates.description: System must be available during specified hours
missingConstraintCandidates.source_text: from <xx:00> to <xx:00>; on <all weekdays/xxx days per year>. The System must be available to users:

missingConstraintCandidates.description: Planned downtime must not exceed specified limits
missingConstraintCandidates.source_text: The planned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx> hours per <rolling three month period>. The System is considered to be down if any user is unable to perform any normal System function and if this failure is attributed to any component of the System other than the workstation.

missingConstraintCandidates.description: Unplanned downtime must not exceed specified limits
missingConstraintCandidates.source_text: Unplanned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx hours/minutes> per <rolling three month period>.

missingConstraintCandidates.description: System must be restorable within specified time after failure
missingConstraintCandidates.source_text: In the event of any software or hardware failure, it must be possible to restore the System (with inline synchronization) within no more than <xx> hours.

missingConstraintCandidates.description: System must provide adequate response times under standard and peak conditions
missingConstraintCandidates.source_text: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

missingConstraintCandidates.description: System must be scalable for different police station sizes
missingConstraintCandidates.source_text: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

Display informative message and suggest alternative searches

exceptions.handling: Display appropriate message based on security settings
